scope: Independent standard-library artifact audit, no study code imported, provider calls, or semantic adjudication. PASS validates accounting, not experiment success.
limits: Retained diagnostic and fresh confirmation are separate cohorts; repeated cases and minimal pairs are dependent.
Mechanical actions are recomputed from raw tool output but material concern quality requires independent blinded semantic review.
Wrong stress hints are authored injections, not a live Jev result.
Provider-reported costs, not independently verified invoices; missing costs and failures stay in denominators.
Service timing includes fresh preparation, Jev where applicable, full critic and validation, but excludes retrieval, auth, durable publication and downstream work.
Observed correct/wrong natural-hint strata are post-call descriptions, not randomized causal effects.
